title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Tier Entry Requirements and Credit Line Ranges
content:
Every Ridgeline Consumer Credit tier sets three entry requirements an applicant is measured against, and the range within which the issuing bank assigns the credit line (revolving card) or the loan amount (Ridgeline Project Loan). The upper figure is also the highest line the tier can ever carry, including after any credit line increase.

## Tier table

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum credit score | 600 | 680 | 740 | 660 | 690 | 720 |
| Minimum applicant age (years) | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 | 18 |
| Minimum stated annual income (USD) | 12000.00 | 30000.00 | 60000.00 | 25000.00 | 40000.00 | 65000.00 |
| Lowest credit line or loan amount assigned (USD) | 300.00 | 3000.00 | 10000.00 | 1500.00 | 5000.00 | 15000.00 |
| Highest credit line or loan amount the tier can carry (USD) | 2900.00 | 9900.00 | 35000.00 | 4999.00 | 14999.00 | 55000.00 |

The tier names in full are Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Classic, Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred, Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier (the revolving cards), and Ridgeline Project Loan 66, Ridgeline Project Loan 78 and Ridgeline Project Loan 84 (the installment loans).

## Reading the figures

- Each requirement is met at or above the figure shown: a credit score of exactly 680 meets the Card Preferred score figure; 679 does not.
- The line range is the band for the line on that tier; a line on Card Preferred is never below 3000.00 and never above 9900.00.

## Hypothetical comparisons (illustrative applicants, not customer facts)

| Applicant (hypothetical) | Tiers whose three figures are all met |
|---|---|
| Score 700, age 30, income 45000.00 | Card Classic, Card Preferred, Project Loan 66, Project Loan 78 |
| Score 745, age 18, income 59000.00 | Card Classic, Card Preferred, Project Loan 66, Project Loan 78 (income is below the Card Premier and Project Loan 84 figures) |
| Score 610, age 17, income 20000.00 | none (age is below 18 on every tier) |
